title: 2031 Prairie stands in stone at the head of its row
items: 2031 Prairie, Samuel Tolman's house at the north end of the 1869 limestone row, is no longer a rough placeholder. It now follows the 1911 fire-insurance map: a three-storey pale limestone front with a tall three-sided bay on its north half, a high stoop to the door on its south half beside 2033's, a bracketed cornice level with its neighbour's, an iron fence, and a two-storey range behind. The 1887 drawing once filed under this address shows a different house, so no picture of 2031 is known and its windows and trim are a careful, labelled guess.
